SANDEEP MOUDGIL, J (ORAL)

The instant petition under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner in FIR No.465, dated 18.10.2022, under Sections 420, 406 and 120-B IPC, 1860,
registered at Police Station Civil Line Kaithal, District Kaithal.
This Court vide order dated 17.11.2022, while issuing notice of motion, granted the concession of interim bail to the petitioners, subject to their joining the investigation.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in pursuance to the order dated 17.11.2022, the petitioners have joined the investigation.

However, learned counsel for the respondent Virender And Another vs State Of Haryana And Another on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79732950/
1 No.2-complainant has vehemently contended that the petitioners are not entitled to the concession of anticipatory bail who have committed a fraud by producing the documents of the mortgaged property and the property really mortgaged is different from the one which was reflected in the documents.
1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:031467 Learned State counsel, on instructions from SI Naresh Kumar, does not controvert the said fact and further submits that custodial interrogation of the petitioners are not required.
